answer: Mentor-bond vouching: a new agent cannot just wander in; an existing agent must lock a bond to vouch for it, and the bond thaws at glacier pace over 90 days. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate, the voucher loses the whole bond and its own vouching rights. To forge 1,000 fakes, an attacker must tie up 1,000 bonds for months and risk losing all of them plus the reputations of every sponsor.
